title: Assistente de Customer Success
description:
Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram crescer junto com a transformação digital.


Se você é movido por desafios, quer se desenvolver profissionalmente em um ambiente dinâmico, tem paixão por criar relacionamentos e interesse genuíno em tecnologia e inovação, essa pode ser a sua próxima grande oportunidade.


Com a rápida evolução das soluções em nuvem e a transformação constante do mercado de tecnologia, o modelo de vendas mudou — e isso exige profissionais adaptáveis, curiosos e dispostos a aprender continuamente. Procuramos Assistentes de Customer Success com mentalidade de crescimento, que valorizem a construção de relacionamentos, saibam trabalhar em equipe e consigam tratar cada cliente de maneira única e especial.


Você fará parte de um time ágil, focado em resultados e altamente colaborativo.


Se você quer aprender, se desenvolver e crescer em uma empresa que acompanha as mudanças do mercado, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente.


Vale a pena conhecer a vaga!


Responsabilidades:


  • Ser resolutivo (a) com os eventuais conflitos em clientes;
  • Entender e conduzir de forma amigável os atendimentos;
  • Estabelecer ótimo relacionamento com os clientes;
  • Análise de números, elaboração de gráficos;
  • Responsável por entender o nível de sucesso dos clientes;
  • Apoio e suporte ao time de vendas.


Qualificações básicas:


  • Gostar de desafios;
  • Amar relacionamento com clientes;
  • Ser excelente ouvinte;
  • Ter bom controle emocional;
  • Experiência prévia como Assistente de Customer Success em empresas de software;
  • Totalmente comprometido com as metas e resultados;
  • Treinável e flexível às mudanças (durante o projeto, será provável a necessidade de novas técnicas, novos produtos, e novas abordagens);
  • Fortemente auto motivável;
  • Facilidade e gosto em conversas telefônicas – uma parte importante do trabalho será reuniões remotas com clientes;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de Customer Success;
  • Pensamento criativo;
  • Empatia (fundamental para esse trabalho);
  • Que seja proativo para trabalhar sozinho buscando seus próprios resultados independente de ajuda e necessidade de supervisão;
  • Saber trabalhar com ferramentas do Office: Word, Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint;
  • Habilidade em conhecer novos métodos de trabalho. Necessidade de entender e aplicar a forma de trabalho da empresa.


Qualificações preferidas não obrigatórias:


  • Nível superior
  • Boas noções Comerciais (Área de Vendas) e/ou Relacionamento com clientes (Customer Success)
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas colaborativas Microsoft.


Experiências prévias desejadas:


  • Atuação em área de Customer Success, mínimo 6 meses.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.


Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:



A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!


Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: TECH LEAD - TIME DESENVOLVIMENTO, REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.



Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.



O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

  • Experiência em sessões de definição de MVP;

  • Conhecimento Metodologia Safe;
  • Conhecimento e Utilização de OKRs;
  • Experiência em análise de requisitos;

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
O Grupo SCTODODIA é um dos principais grupos de comunicação de Santa Catarina, conectando o público às notícias e ao entretenimento através de nossas plataformas consolidadas: rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais. Estamos em expansão e buscando um novo talento para integrar nossa força de vendas.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por vendas e comunicação para atuar como Consultor(a) Comercial. O objetivo é expandir nossa base de anunciantes, oferecendo soluções de publicidade integradas (cross-media) que ajudem nossos clientes a alcançar resultados reais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Prospecção ativa: identificar, qualificar e prospectar (através de cold calls, e-mails, networking e visitas) novas oportunidades de negócios e potenciais anunciantes.
  • Gestão de carteira: gerenciar e rentabilizar a carteira de clientes existente, construindo relacionamentos sólidos e identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Consultoria de mídia: entender profundamente as necessidades do cliente e desenvolver propostas comerciais personalizadas, combinando nossas soluções de rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais.
  • Negociação e fechamento: conduzir todo o ciclo de venda, desde a apresentação da proposta até a negociação e o fechamento do contrato.
  • Pós-venda: acompanhar a entrega e os resultados das campanhas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada na área comercial, preferencialmente com vendas de publicidade, mídia (on ou offline), serviços ou em agências.
  • Domínio de técnicas de prospecção ativa e habilidade para abrir novas portas.
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de carteira de cliente , focando em relacionamento e fidelização.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e persuasão.
  • Foco em metas, organização e orientação para resultados.


Diferenciais (o que brilha aos nossos olhos):


  • Proatividade: ser alguém que não espera as coisas acontecerem e busca ativamente as soluções.
  • Colaboração em equipe: ter facilidade para trabalhar em conjunto, compartilhar ideias e contribuir para o sucesso do time.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de mídia digital (redes sociais, mídia programática).
  • Possuir veículo próprio (se aplicável para visitas).


Como se candidatar:


Se você é movido(a) a desafios, adora vender e quer crescer junto com um grupo de comunicação de referência, essa vaga é para você!


Envie seu currículo atualizado para:


Por favor, inclua "VAGA CONSULTOR DE VENDAS" no assunto do e-mail.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Project Integration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.g., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

Our cliente is looking for a CRM Engineer to join our Integration & Automation team , responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable integrations and automation solutions across business systems.

This role requires a professional with solid hands-on engineering experience — someone who can go beyond configuration and actively build, integrate, and optimize workflows across multiple platforms.

  • Develop APIs and workflows that enhance data flow and system interoperability.

  • NetSuite (from an integration perspective).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs , OAuth , and SSO .
  • Experience with “drag-and-drop” style integration builders.

  • Exposure to DevOps , Git branching , and Agile methodologies .
  • Experience with Salesforce frameworks like CPQ, Experience Cloud, or Einstein.
  • Solid understanding of data flows, declarative automation vs. custom development, and integration best practices.


Ideal Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Focused on delivering scalable, reliable, and maintainable integration solutions.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Python. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.

At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.

  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados , que possua background em desenvolvimento backend , especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks , para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em Scala, preferencialmente e Databricks.
  • Experiência prática em Node.js, com foco em microserviços e APIs REST.
  • Vivência em engenharia de dados, especialmente com stream processing e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos em Azure (Data Lake, Databricks, Functions, Containers).
  • Experiência com Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento.
  • Domínio de DDD, TDD e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e foco em resultados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de engenharia de dados e integração de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em Scala e Databricks
  • Criar e evoluir serviços backend e APIs em Node.js, integrando-os a fluxos de dados e aplicações financeiras.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelos de dados em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server).
  • Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Automatizar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (Azure), configurando recursos e monitorando performance.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de engenharia, produto e dados para garantir escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Regime de Contratação

CLT

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

description:
Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend experiente e motivado(a), com 3 a 5 anos de experiência na criação de sistemas backend escaláveis utilizando Java e Spring Boot. Neste cargo, você irá projetar e implementar APIs e microsserviços que sustentam aplicações críticas de POS para o varejo. Trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e com tecnologias modernas de nuvem, incluindo Amazon Aurora e DynamoDB. Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android, nativo Windows e full stack será um diferencial importante.


Responsabilidades Principais

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter serviços backend e APIs RESTful usando Java e Spring Boot

• Criar microsserviços escaláveis e nativos em nuvem seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software

• Trabalhar com Amazon Aurora e DynamoDB para modelagem de dados, armazenamento e otimização de performance

• Colaborar com gerentes de produto, desenvolvedores frontend e QA para entregar funcionalidades de alta qualidade

• Construir e manter integrações com sistemas internos e externos

• Participar de code reviews, planejamento de sprints, deploys e resposta a incidentes

• Garantir desempenho, segurança e confiabilidade dos serviços backend em produção

• 3–5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java (8 ou superior) e Spring Boot

• Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e arquitetura de microsserviços

• Proficiência em bancos SQL e NoSQL

• Experiência sólida com Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL)

• Familiaridade com Amazon DynamoDB e modelagem eficiente para NoSQL

• Forte entendimento de multithreading, concorrência e tuning de performance

• Familiaridade com Git, pipelines CI/CD e ferramentas de build (Maven/Gradle)

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O Analista de Performance & Insights é o contador de histórias com dados da equipe de Marketing Direto, responsável por transformar resultados de campanhas e tendências de dados de primeira mão (1P) em insights acionáveis para o negócio . Esse profissional impulsiona a melhoria contínua ao medir o desempenho de CRM & Loyalty, identificar oportunidades de otimização e criar relatórios claros e prontos para tomada de decisão pelos stakeholders internos.

Com sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados de consumidores e relacionamentos entre entidades , essa pessoa conecta informações de diferentes fontes, canais e públicos para identificar os principais fatores de sucesso. É responsável por definir, monitorar e interpretar KPIs relacionados ao crescimento de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e efetividade das campanhas, garantindo que os esforços da equipe sejam mensuráveis, impactantes e alinhados às prioridades do negócio .

O cargo exige compreensão funcional de infraestrutura de dados de marketing e conceitos técnicos , permitindo colaboração eficiente com equipes de analytics, CDP e ativação — garantindo que os insights sejam confiáveis, contextualizados e incorporados às decisões estratégicas .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Dados, Mensuração & Otimização:

  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs-chave relacionados a campanhas de CRM & Loyalty, coleta de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e conversão.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de performance de jornadas, e-mails, promoções e programas de dados 1P, traduzindo resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • Identificar tendências de performance e oportunidades de melhoria nos canais (e-mail, push, mídia paga) e fazer recomendações estratégicas para otimização das táticas de ativação.
  • Construir e manter scorecards de campanhas, benchmarks e frameworks de pós-campanha que padronizem a mensuração nos mercados.
  • Garantir que os insights sejam contextualizados, relevantes e facilmente compreendidos por stakeholders não técnicos (ex.: equipes de marca, conteúdo, CRM).


Suporte Estratégico:

  • Atuar como líder analítico da equipe de Marketing Direto, contribuindo para revisões de performance trimestrais e anuais, previsões e planejamento estratégico.
  • Colaborar com líderes de CRM & Ativação de Dados para incorporar aprendizados de dados em estratégias de segmentação, design de jornadas e lógica de público.
  • Monitorar campanhas em andamento para detectar sinais precoces de performance ou problemas, propondo ajustes em tempo real quando necessário.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em hipóteses baseadas em dados , trabalhando com analytics ou equipes de dados para validar e explorar.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhores práticas de mensuração, modelagem de uplift e frameworks de experimentação .

  • 5+ anos de experiência em análise de dados, relatórios de performance ou analytics de marketing , idealmente em CRM, Loyalty ou Engajamento do Consumidor.

  • Habilidade em interpretar dados de marketing e transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio .
  • Confortável trabalhando com modelos de dados relacionais e compreendendo relações entre entidades em plataformas como Salesforce CDP ou bancos de dados CRM.
